config-editor.noPool: The site runs no PHP, so no pool is rendered
config-editor.pick: Pick a site to edit its configuration
config-editor.poolHint: Lines appended to the pool of {domain}; a later line wins over the default
config-editor.serverHint: Directives placed inside the server block of {domain}; nginx -t checks them before they are kept
config-editor.title: Site configuration

error.block: The block opened on line {line} is never closed
error.directive: Line {line} is not an override the panel allows: a listed directive ending in a semicolon, a location or if block, a closing brace or a comment
error.setting: Line {line} is not a pool setting the panel allows: a process manager setting or a PHP value, flag or admin value
error.text: Only printable text, line breaks and tabs are allowed

site.dnsZone: Create a DNS zone for the domain

error.alias_twice: The alias {name} repeats the domain or another alias
error.detached: The site renderer has not started yet
error.exists: The name {name} is already served by a site
error.foreign_zone: {name} lies in a DNS zone of another account
error.home: The home directory {home} is not a plain absolute path
error.name: {name} is not a host name
error.root: {root} is not a relative path inside the home directory
error.site_id: The site id {site} is not an id
error.tls_path: The certificate path {path} is not a plain absolute path
error.user_busy: The user still serves {sites} site(s); delete them first
error.user_gone: The hosting user {user} of the site does not exist on the host
error.user_pending: The hosting user {user} is not ready yet

site.letsEncrypt: Request a Let's Encrypt certificate for the domain and its aliases
site.root: Document root, inside the user's home directory
